description: In the busy final days of the 2022 Legislative Session, Representative Ricks ensured that small businesses were recognized for their crucial community contributions and hard work by leading a House Tribute in honor of Small Business Week at the Colorado Capitol on May 6, 2022.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Naquetta Ricks for Colorado
title: Honoring Small Business Week 2022 — State Representative Naquetta Ricks HD40
